positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designs, develops, documents, tests and debugs applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions.
•	Ensures software standards are met.
•	Maintain and improve the software CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, bug free delivery of critical business software to production.
•	Set up and deploy Development, Test, and Build environments
•	Create and update Windows installers
•	Install, test, and verify software products
•	Maintain multiple baseline repositories
•	Provide support for the software build and installation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design, develop, and implement software engineering applications, including but not limited to: real-time software design, controls algorithm software implementation and user-interface design and development, testing and certification
•	Assist in the analysis and investigation of major software engineering project task including hardware/software compatibility of interface design issues
•	Integration of software components into software/hardware systems or subsystems
•	Assist in the definition of design specifications and parameters, development and application of major routines and utility programs
•	Support analysis of systems architecture requirements and development

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Classification of Signals from a Wideband Receiver using Machine Learning Techniques.  Involved running simulations of classification using MATLAB

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: Having a Semester GPA of 3.5 or higher while taking 12 units or more
honors.issuer: Issued by Dean of the College of Engineering & Computer Science · May 2016

honors.title: Eagles Scout
honors.description:
Highest Honor Awarded by the Boy Scouts of America. 

For my Eagle Scout Project, I sent care packages overseas to military personnel in Afghanistan filled with snacks, toiletries, socks, t-shirts, and other items to help them pass the time.  I organized a collection drive for the items by handing out flyers in several neighborhoods and visited local charity organizations for assistance to raise money for the shipping costs.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jun 2012

projects.title: SmartPitch - Automatic Pitching Machine
projects.description:
SmartPitch is the automation of a normal pitching machine.  Using motors to control angle and tilt of the wheels and a microcontroller to control the wheel speed of the main motors, SmartPitch can deliver a random sequence of pitches to give the batter in game experience unlike any other.

I was in charge of the app design. I programmed the app using Java & XML in Android Studio.
